comment.body: Thanks for the concrete report about Mouse Without Borders isn't working properly, including the version, affected PowerToys area, and observed behavior. The remaining ambiguity is the exact failing path or whether this still reproduces on a current build, so a generic checklist would not help. Please retest on the latest stable build and provide numbered steps naming one affected dialog/application and one unaffected application, the two-PC Windows versions, elevation state, and whether reconnecting or the local trackpad clears the failure; comment /bugreport after reproducing if possible. This will distinguish the competing triage paths and determine whether the proposed fix should target the reported behavior or a different configuration or lifecycle condition.
